messages:
Ria: Morning check — quick snapshot:
- Open tickets: 18 (3 high)
- Yesterday: closed 4 low-priority, applied 'embed-fallback' macro to two tickets
- Known issues: webhook retries spike, embeddings latency > SLO for some customers
What I did: cleaned queue, flagged #SUP-4389 for escalation
Blockers: need wording confirmation for external-facing webhook macro (legal review?)
Today: scrub high-priority, attach macro PR, hand off overnight coverage.

Omar: Taking #SUP-4392 (webhook) — seeing repeated 429s in recent logs. I can triage and correlate with customer request-ids. Suggest small wording change for retry macro to set expectations.

Jen: ping @eng-infra for SSO logs on cust-acme. Any ETA? Also have a tiny PR ready that tweaks a couple of macros (PR #1043).

Leo: I can review PR #1043 after this check-in. Taking overnight on-call shift — will watch for escalations.

Maya: FYI — embeddings perf regression traced to new quant profile on redwood-embed-v2. Rolling fallback to v1 for affected tenants now. Creating an incident for tracking (INC-2026).

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026 created by Maya — embeddings regression. https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026

Ria: Thanks Maya. I'll add a short note to customer-facing macro about degraded embeddings and a mitigation line. Will attach the edited macro to PR before EOD. :thumbsup:

Omar: Quick grep/jq to find recent webhook 429s if useful:
```
jq '.events[] | select(.status==429)' /var/log/webhook.json | head -n 20
```

Jen: Assigning #SUP-4389 to Omar, moving #SUP-4360 to backlog. If anyone edits webhook macro, include a `request_id` example snippet in the template. :eyes:

Ria: OK — will update macros and add a short internal note for on-call. If legal needs to review the external wording, please loop them in (cc: @ops and @prod-comms).

Omar: I'll post follow-up in thread once I have the first batch of logs correlated.

Leo: Thanks all — tagging for visibility.
